title: Villagers And Workstations+
description: This mod adds many new villager workstations and items that are unique to each villager
body:
adds lots of custom villagers, workbenches and items, that make your villagers feel fresh and special.

Items (all obtainable from new villagers) 
-Medkit (heals)
-Shield Potion (adds absortion effect, like a golden apple does)
-Bandage (heals)
-Enchanted Shield Potion (better version of shield potion)
-Lava Bow (shoots lava arrows)
-Lava Arrow (can only be shot from lava bow and catches entites on fire)
-Warden Totem (spawns a warden)
-Bee Totem (spawns a bee farm)
-Raid Totem (gives bad omen effect)
-Along with a bunch of different blocks

Also adds 10 new villager types (and maybe more in the future)
